Chapter 6831: Let’S See What You Can Do

Chapter 6831: Let’s See What You Can Do

“Just a passerby.” Li Qiye smiled.

This didn’t make sense to listeners because such a powerful being must have been in Heavenrealm for a long time. No one else from the minor realms could possess so much power.

“Boom!” Meanwhile, Apexblade lost utterly to the four overlords and fell to Golden Lamp. When he smashed into the ground, flesh and bones splattered everywhere.

“Help me!” Absolute saw hope after seeing the four overlords beating their foe.

“Stay.” Li Qiye’s will immobilized Absolute entirely. The process resembled an invisible divine spear crucifying the target permanently.

“You dare?!” Gluttonous Wolf shouted.

“Of course.” Li Qiye’s voice suddenly appeared above.

They couldn’t keep up with his speed. It felt as if Li Qiye didn’t move but rather, dimensions stacked together and dragged them to him. However, this wasn’t the case. Thus, they couldn’t explain this strange phenomenon.

Some among them had met primordial immortals before. Alas, they couldn’t describe his movement.

“Who are you?” Dark Emissary finally showed emotion, clearly feeling threatened.

They felt as if they were looking at something monstrous - too gigantic to envision fully.

“The one to stabilize Stygian and destroy Devouring Alliance.” Li Qiye smiled and declared casually.

The overlords became startled. Although their alliance had been taken down before, they still resurfaced to rule Stygian. This notion was absurd.

As for the defenders of Golden Lamp, they saw a scene of the light reaching all corners.

“Bold words, you aren’t the first to try.” Dark Emissary said.

“Your immortals might be able to struggle a bit. Your group, forget it.” Li Qiye smiled.

“Let’s see what you can do.” Primal Eagle released all of his feathers again, illuminating the sky white. Saber intent drowned everything, capable of massacring countless beings.

“That’s it?” Li Qiye utilized his will, causing the sabers to wail.

The eagle was confused at first, unable to control the feather blades. All of a sudden, they pierced him instead.

He bellowed in agony and confusion. His feathers were imbued with his dao and polished through the eras. He always had full control over them until today.
